name: finassist-real-world-annual-reports-v1
description: Manually labelled questions grounded in two official public annual-report PDFs. PDF page numbers are one-based and match PyMuPDF/application citations.

cases.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue in fiscal 2025?
cases.relevant_evidence: Fiscal Year 2025 Summary: Revenue $130,497 million for the year ended January 26, 2025.

cases.question: What was NVIDIA's operating income in fiscal 2025?
cases.expected_answer: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 operating income was $81,453 million.
cases.relevant_evidence: Fiscal Year 2025 Summary: Operating income $81,453 million, up 147%.

cases.question: How did NVIDIA's revenue change between fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025?
cases.expected_answer: Revenue increased from $60.922 billion in fiscal 2024 to $130.497 billion in fiscal 2025, an increase of 114%.
cases.relevant_evidence: The fiscal-year summary reports revenue of $130,497 million and $60,922 million and labels the change as up 114%.

cases.question: What drove NVIDIA's Data Center revenue growth in fiscal 2025?
cases.expected_answer: Data Center growth was driven by demand for Hopper accelerated computing used for large language models, recommendation engines, and generative AI applications; Ethernet for AI also contributed.
cases.relevant_evidence: Pages 130 and 133 attribute growth to Hopper-based accelerated computing and AI workloads, with Ethernet for AI including Spectrum-X also contributing.

cases.question: What supply and product-transition risks could affect NVIDIA's gross margins?
cases.expected_answer: Long lead times, supply-demand mismatches, component shortages, non-cancellable commitments, low yields, inventory provisions, and difficult architecture transitions could raise costs or reduce gross margins.
cases.relevant_evidence: The risk discussion spans supply availability and commitments, demand forecasting, inventory provisions, product-transition complexity, quality or yield problems, and supplier dependence.

cases.question: What debt-to-equity ratio did NVIDIA report for fiscal 2025?
cases.relevant_evidence: The report contains debt and equity balances but does not explicitly report a fiscal-2025 debt-to-equity ratio.

cases.question: What was NVIDIA's profit in fiscal 2025?
cases.relevant_evidence: The report provides gross margin, operating income, and net income; the word profit does not uniquely identify which measure is requested.

cases.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue in fiscal 2030?
cases.relevant_evidence: Fiscal 2030 is outside the supplied report and no fiscal-2030 revenue is disclosed.

cases.question: What were The Coca-Cola Company's net operating revenues in 2024?
cases.expected_answer: The Coca-Cola Company's 2024 net operating revenues were $47,061 million.
cases.relevant_evidence: Pages 48 and 64 report 2024 net operating revenues of $47,061 million.

cases.question: What was The Coca-Cola Company's operating income in 2024?
cases.expected_answer: The Coca-Cola Company's 2024 operating income was $9,992 million.
cases.relevant_evidence: Pages 51 and 64 report operating income of $9,992 million for 2024.

cases.question: How did Coca-Cola's consolidated operating margin change from 2023 to 2024?
cases.expected_answer: Consolidated operating margin decreased from 24.7% in 2023 to 21.2% in 2024.
cases.relevant_evidence: The operating-margin table on PDF page 51 lists 21.2% for 2024 and 24.7% for 2023.

cases.question: What factors caused Coca-Cola's operating income to decrease in 2024?
cases.expected_answer: The decrease was primarily driven by higher commodity costs, higher selling, general and administrative expenses, higher other operating charges, bottling refranchising, and an unfavorable foreign-currency impact, partly offset by volume growth and pricing.
cases.relevant_evidence: PDF page 51 explains the drivers of the $1,319 million, or 12%, operating-income decrease.

cases.question: How did Coca-Cola's worldwide unit case volume and net operating revenues change from 2023 to 2024?
cases.expected_answer: Worldwide unit case volume rose from 33.3 billion to 33.7 billion cases, while net operating revenues rose from $45,754 million to $47,061 million, a 3% revenue increase.
cases.relevant_evidence: PDF page 7 supplies both unit-case volumes; PDF page 48 supplies both revenue values and the 3% increase.

cases.question: What debt-to-equity ratio did Coca-Cola report for 2024?
cases.relevant_evidence: The report includes debt and equity amounts but does not explicitly report a 2024 debt-to-equity ratio.

cases.question: How did Coca-Cola perform in 2024?
cases.relevant_evidence: The question does not identify a metric or aspect of performance and should be clarified rather than reduced to one selected figure.

cases.question: What were Coca-Cola's net operating revenues in 2026?
cases.relevant_evidence: The supplied report covers 2024 and earlier comparative periods, not 2026 results.
